newsitem.title: FRANCE: CS First Boston ups Canal+ to strong buy.
newsitem.headline: CS First Boston ups Canal+ to strong buy.

text.p: CS First Boston raised its rating on French subscriber television operator Canal Plus on Tuesday to strong buy from buy.
The move was announced after Canal+ said last Friday it was merging with Dutch satellite television company Nethold. Nethold is jointly held by Richemont and MCL-Multi Choice.
CS First Boston said the merger moved Canal+ into the position of "premier growth play in European pay television."
